1.mascotDialogue: Extract-max na really two movement — swap the root with the last leaf, shrink the heap by one, then make that displaced value sink to where she truly belong.

2.mascotDialogue: Lines 4 and 5 dey find the biggest of the node and her two children. Line 8 recursive call — na wetin let the displaced value continue sinking, past more than one level, if she need to.

3.mascotDialogue: 9 dey sit for top, and every parent dey beat both her children, all the way down. Same array-index maths as min heap — just the comparison, flipped.

4.mascotDialogue: The swap alone no dey finish the job! Without siftDown, you just relocate the problem to the top of the tree — you never solve am at all.
